text_block_list.text:
An injured Stay Gold was taken to the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It doesn't hurt all that much, it's 
nothing serious.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'll rest a little, then head back to 
training.
choice_data_list: No no, being careless is wrong

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
It's fine. I get plenty of injuries like 
this when I'm travelling.
choice_data_list: No, we can't let our guard down.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You won't let me huh. Even if that's the 
case, I kinda want to go for a run right 
now.
choice_data_list: No, no, I can't allow that...!

text_block_list.text:
Her way of talking made me hesitate for a 
moment.
She's like a kid who won't take no 
for an answer and go run anyway…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Hey, am I realllllly not allowed to go 
train? ……I'm begging you.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Can't help it.
I'll behave and rest today, 
because you're the one who is in charge
of 
me.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That's right,
going for a stroll should be 
fine right?
If I could just go outside for 
a bit…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That's strict. Then I guess I'll go for a 
nap on the rooftop, in my trusty hammock 
of course.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Aah～…As I thought, it's kind of serious…… It's hurting a lot more now……

It appears that suddenly moving made Stay 
Gold's injury worse. We will have to give 
up on training this time.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I feel completely fine. So long I 
pace myself, I'm going to do this!

Just like that, we successfully completed 
a light training session!
